cohort: Female health workers from four hospitals in Kumasi, Ghana, participated in a survey (n=180) and focus group discussion (n=8).
finding: While most health workers (73%) initiated breastfeeding within one hour, nearly half (49%) did not practice exclusive breastfeeding for six months due to work-related barriers and limited social support.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with lower odds of initiating breastfeeding within one hour after birth compared to vaginal delivery.
